caption:
🏄‍♂️ Sayulita is just the beginning. Within an hour's drive, you'll find some of Mexico's most legendary waves — each break with its own personality.

🌊 Sayulita — The heartbeat of Nayarit surfing. Mellow beach break, perfect for all levels.

🌊 Punta de Mita — 20 min south. World-class right-handers over reef. Consistent and powerful.

🌊 El Anclote — Gentle point break near Punta de Mita. Long, smooth rides. Perfect for longboards.

🌊 La Lancha (Stinky's) — Punchy beach break between Sayulita and Punta de Mita. Fewer crowds, more power.

🌊 Chacala — 45 min north. Crescent bay, jungle-framed fishing village, soft playful surf all day long.

Base yourself at SkyHouse Sayulita — your base camp for the best surf coast in Mexico. 🤙
